provenance.method: Separate built-in image generation call per banner, using the photo-grounded championship transcription. Native PNG bytes preserved without resizing, resampling, recompression, or C2PA removal.
provenance.excluded: Original photos, student names, individual awards and personal rosters.
provenance.png_metadata: Each file contains IHDR, IDAT, IEND and caBX chunks. caBX preserves C2PA AI-generation provenance. No EXIF, GPS, XMP, text, ICC or personal-location chunks were found.
provenance.physical_dimensions: Not surveyed; use established scene geometry and preserve the listed native aspect ratios.

wall_layout.A_RECENT_END: Opposite scoreboard end: 6 columns in rows 1–2. Row 3: girls tennis at column 1; blank column 2; older red-outline 2007/2008 group at columns 3–5. Tall navy KING padding and gold 1865 floor baseline below.
wall_layout.B_BENCH_SIDELINE: Long team-bench wall perpendicular to A and C. Continuous chronological upper strip: 17 banners, but a large Vikings shield gap between columns 9 and 10. Lower 2024 banners hang under approximately upper columns 1–2 and 3–4. American flag at C-end corner after column 17.
wall_layout.C_SCOREBOARD_END: Opposite A: 9×2 main grid. Column 10 row 1 is isolated to the RIGHT of the scoreboard, above FAA fair-play panel, not contiguous with grid. Navy KING pads below; U.S. flag at left corner.
wall_layout.D_BLEACHER_SIDELINE: Opposite B: compact 6×2 2015–2018 grid above folded wooden bleachers, immediately left of large projecting white wall and elevated white-railed platform with KING cloth. Upper-right banner is partly hidden by that projection.
